logical_contracts.name: BuildConfiguration
logical_contracts.invariant: Sphinx config is validated, serializes only intended client-safe fields, and has explicit ownership.

logical_contracts.name: ClientSafeSerialization
logical_contracts.invariant: Production secrets never enter generated HTML/browser globals.

logical_contracts.name: BrowserRuntime
logical_contracts.invariant: Browser owns presentation/state only; security decisions remain server-enforced.

logical_contracts.name: RepresentationConsumer
logical_contracts.invariant: Assistant consumes canonical static representation instead of owning canonical conversion.

logical_contracts.name: PromptAuthority
logical_contracts.invariant: Server owns system policy; client/page content cannot set authoritative system role.

logical_contracts.name: EndpointDiscovery
logical_contracts.invariant: Discovery is non-secret, schema-versioned, and client/server drift is tested.

logical_contracts.name: ProxyRouting
logical_contracts.invariant: Server credentials are destination-bound to approved upstreams.

logical_contracts.name: CorsOriginPolicy
logical_contracts.invariant: Production CORS is explicit least privilege; parallel relays match policy.

logical_contracts.name: ShareAuthorization
logical_contracts.invariant: Read ID/capability does not imply edit/delete authority.

logical_contracts.name: ClientIdentity
logical_contracts.invariant: Forwarded identity is accepted only from trusted proxy boundary.

logical_contracts.name: RequestLimits
logical_contracts.invariant: Body/resource limits prevent pre-validation memory exhaustion.

logical_contracts.name: ModelServicePolicy
logical_contracts.invariant: Direct model endpoint enforces role/policy invariants independently of UI.

logical_contracts.name: FeedbackProvenance
logical_contracts.invariant: Persisted feedback/training data has consent/provenance and is never implicitly trusted.

logical_contracts.name: SettingsRegistry
logical_contracts.invariant: Client settings have one validated schema/write path with explicit persistence and sensitivity.

logical_contracts.name: CorpusBoundary
logical_contracts.invariant: Corpus owns retrieval/evidence semantics; assistant consumes published retrieval contracts.

logical_contracts.name: MCPBoundary
logical_contracts.invariant: MCP owns protocol transport; assistant does not invent parallel MCP semantics.

logical_contracts.name: RuntimeHtmlFallback
logical_contracts.invariant: DOM conversion remains observable fallback during staged static migration, not canonical target.

logical_contracts.name: ServiceParity
logical_contracts.invariant: Alternative service paths cannot bypass auth/CORS/routing/model-policy controls.
